title: KAYFABE demo update: new wrestling animations and a new trailer
author: laughing_gorilla123
selftext:
I've updated the free demo of KAYFABE, a management game about running a small independent wrestling promotion.



You book the cards, pay the wrestlers and deal with the problems backstage. The demo covers your first three shows, and you can play in your browser or download the Windows version.



This update adds two-wrestler pixel animations to the match broadcasts, a timed pinfall three-count and winner announcements. I've also updated the trailer.



I'd appreciate any feedback on whether the match animations look natural and the moves are easy to follow. Thank you for taking a look.



Free demo: [https://forty-slop.itch.io/kayfabe-demo](https://forty-slop.itch.io/kayfabe-demo)

Trailer: [https://youtu.be/1L-Li73aUYU](https://youtu.be/1L-Li73aUYU)

Steam wishlist: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5389060/KAYFABE/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5389060/KAYFABE/)
